title: CMCE Core Integration Foundation — Mandatory Gate Before CEL + abilities registry hygiene

new_hard_class_invariants.description: No mutation may enter the CEL without either a PASSED CMCE consensus record or an active, logged exemption under the narrow Phase 199+ exemption policy.
new_hard_class_invariants.rationale: Establishes CMCE as the non-bypassable constitutional gate for all high-stakes mutations (foundational deliverable of Epoch A).

new_hard_class_invariants.description: Exemptions to CMCE-GATE-0 must be explicitly declared with a permitted scope, a rationale of at least 80 characters, and recorded in the CMCE ledger before the mutation may proceed.
new_hard_class_invariants.rationale: Prevents abuse of exemptions while still allowing emergency/ bootstrap / drift-closure paths under strict audit.

new_hard_class_invariants.description: High-level ADAAD abilities (e.g. cmce.consensus) must be registered in both runtime capability_graph and static data/capabilities.json, owned by the correct 5-element (Water for cmce), and cross-linked in Phase 199 governance artifacts.
new_hard_class_invariants.rationale: Makes CMCE (and future high-stakes engines) first-class visible abilities for UI/DORK/telemetry without bypassing constitutional gates.

notes: DEVADAAD hygiene run recorded cmce.consensus abilities registration as part of Phase 199 Track A. Implemented adaad/abilities/registry.py + base.py (lightweight isolated registry with protocol pattern). Full ratification follows Phase 198 GPG + four-surface (now clean).

invariants.description: Sandbox execution NEVER touches live ledger or live module state.
Identical seed + mutation spec MUST produce identical delta.
Every sandbox run MUST emit a signed BehavioralDelta record.
Sandbox ledger entries MUST form unbroken HMAC-SHA256 chain.
Committed sandbox ledger entries are append-only; no mutations or deletes.
HUMAN-0 holds sole authority to promote or permanently discard sandbox results.
Live promotion REQUIRES a PASSED sandbox run sealed in the ledger.
Sandbox scope MUST match the declared blast_radius of the mutation.
Any sandbox run MUST be deterministically replayable from its seed + spec.
All sandbox operations logged with ISO-8601 timestamps and HUMAN-0 attribution.
